projection.kind: albers conic equal area, one conic per region
projection.formula: n = (sin f1 + sin f2)/2; C = cos^2 f1 + 2 n sin f1; p = sqrt(C - 2 n sin f)/n; p0 = sqrt(C - 2 n sin f0)/n; t = n (l - l0), l - l0 wrapped into -180..180 degrees; x = p sin t; y = p0 - p cos t; screen = [translate[0] + scale*x, translate[1] - scale*y]. f1/f2 = parallels, f0 = origin, l0 = meridian, all in degrees, radians inside. The lower48 region takes every STATEFP that no other region lists. A region with a clip [x0, y0, x1, y1] (screen pixels) draws only inside it, as d3's clipExtent: a point outside it is not drawn and a ring is cut to it.

build.path_rings: each ring ends with Z and does not repeat its first point; close the ring before any point-in-polygon test
build.equal_area_check: projected px^2 / true m^2 lands within 0.1% of scale^2/R^2 for the large low-water states (NM +0.02%, KS -0.03%, CO -0.09%), which is the equal-area property holding; small and water-heavy states differ by the 20m source generalisation, not by the projection
